selection_rule: Every currently unheld Stack v3 record without a Git-verified host origin in the linked evidence; all 44 pinned records, no substitutions or ranking.
findings: All 44 remaining unheld Stack v3 records were attempted at their original pinned commits, without replacement or branch-head substitution. Forty-two new host origins match consumed SHA256, upstream plain SHA1 and Git blob identity.

Twenty-seven complete repository trees establish 38 file identities. Four files from huihuang-chen/code and kaist-ina/Extractocol have recursive trees exceeding the 2 MiB response cap. Smaller contents-API requests at the same pinned revisions verify their path, blob identity and exact decoded bytes within the original request budget. Their ancestor-notice searches remain incomplete; path verification does not imply a complete tree or complete notice coverage.

Two gokberkgunduzz/thesis-project files return HTTP 404 at their pinned revision. They remain unresolved and outside training; no newer revision or substitute file was used. One had a prior failed attempt, preserved in the earlier receipt.

Fifteen distinct ancestor notice files are Git-verified for 22 selected records. This is notice availability, not a new notice-applicability review. An empty notice list after a complete bounded filename search differs from an incomplete tree search and does not prove the absence of terms elsewhere.

A metadata-only view joins origin evidence to all 218 existing assessment records. Unheld Stack v3 coverage is 68 verified / two attempted unresolved / zero unattempted. Unheld Stack-Edu coverage remains 18 verified / one attempted unresolved / 85 not attempted in linked receipts. Held records remain a separate disjoint category; all original denominators and observed tokens reconcile.

Host provenance does not resolve copied-source attribution, dependency notices, family/near-duplicate exclusions or intended-use suitability. Observed tokens in each evidence category are not eligible supply. No sample quality ranking or extrapolated corpus yield follows.
boundaries: The complete 218-record assessment is byte-identical to its input; all original metadata/weights, 176 reads and 44 family holds are preserved. The derived inventory adds evidence fields only.
No corpus code execution, new semantic-reading claims, held-task inspection, source-use approval, eligible supply estimate, source ranking, training admission or GPU work.
